technique_name: Discuss the use of GPT models for language generation tasks.
description: GPT models are a type of language model developed by OpenAI and used in natural language processing (NLP). They are based on a deep neural network architecture, and can generate natural-sounding and grammatically correct responses to given prompts. GPT models are used in tasks such as question-answering, automatic summarization, natural language generation, and text understanding.
